result.title: Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop Position Paper Track
result.summary: Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. We define subgroup differences in clinical task error across sampling procedures and provide a mathematical example showing that two groups can have identical outputs under the exact dynamics and a reference sampler but different errors under an alternative sampler. We also extend this result to stochastic generation under shared noise. An exploratory experiment with an age-conditioned image generation model illustrates how changing the number and timing of sampling steps can alter image-derived measurements, although these differences do not establish clinical unfairness. We therefore argue that fairness evaluation should assess the sampling procedure used in practice and examine intermediate generation states when they help explain differences in clinically relevant errors across patient groups. Analysis code is available here https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness

AI.brief_summary: 论文主张 diffusion/flow 医学图像生成的公平性评估应把采样过程（步数、调度、求解器）视为被评估系统的一部分，给出两组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出相同、但换用其他采样器后临床任务误差不同的数学例子，并用年龄条件生成模型的探索性实验说明采样步数与时机可改变图像衍生测量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「采样路径与中间生成状态决定下游测量」的论证，可能为 LVR 中迭代 latent 状态更新、计算量分配与停止决策的评价提供概念线索，但论文面向公平性而非推理，可迁移性需核查。
